messages:
sara (primary): quick handoff — we're in an active mitigation for KV cache evictions in eu-west-1. saw the pager at ~11:02 UTC, root cause looks like a sudden memory pressure on the embeddings cache nodes. currently: ~40% eviction rate, p95 latency up 220ms vs baseline. customers affected: chat-heavy tenants on eu-west-1 (IDs: T-124, T-209).

jamal (secondary): on it. i left the bridge running, i'm re-checking the shard placement. last action: increased cache-memory limit on pool-eu-embed-3 by 15% (will take ~30s to stabilize).

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-478. Pager triggered: embeddings-cache-eviction-rate > 30% for 5m. Severity: S2. Runbook: /runbooks/kv-cache-eviction (link).

sara (primary): mitigation steps done so far:
- scaled pool-eu-embed-3 +1 pod (kubectl patch deployment embed-pool-eu-3 --replicas=3)
- temporarily pinned some noisy tenants to eu-central fallback routing (policy id: route-fallback-2026-02)
- disabled aggressive prefetch on pool-eu-embed-3 (flag: PREFETCH_BATCH=0)

leo (shift-lead): note — we have a coverage gap in 02:00–06:00 UTC where jamal is unavailable (PTO). need volunteer for secondary for that window or confirm auto-escalation to oncall-next.

maria (prod-sre): i can cover secondary 02:00–04:00 UTC. recommend jamal handoff details include the quick commands to revert routing.

jamal (secondary): handing off to maria for 02:00–04:00, i'll be back at 04:30. next steps for whoever takes over:
1) check eviction metric: grafana -> Embeddings / Cache -> eviction_rate_pctl90
2) if eviction_rate > 25% for >3m: run restart on affected pods: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/embed-pool-eu-embed-3 -n infra`
3) run temporary routing: `POST /api/v1/routing/override {"policy": "route-fallback-2026-02", "targets": ["eu-central-1"]}`
4) escalate to infra if underlying host mem pressure persists: page infra-oncall (tag @infra-oncall)

sara (primary): customer impact summary to include in postmortem: degraded generation latency (p95 +220ms), some timeouts in long-chat sessions for T-124. no data loss reported. will monitor for errors >1% in generation_error_rate.

ops-bot: Update: metric eviction_rate decreased to 18% after scale and prefetch toggle.

leo (shift-lead): good. action items for next shift:
- maria: be primary backup 02:00–04:00 (confirmed)
- oncall-next: please monitor for re-increase in evictions and stand ready to trigger route-fallback if >25% sustained.
- create short-term incident note for customers: ops / status page (sara to draft).

sara (primary): drafting status update now. paste below for review: 
> We are investigating elevated cache evictions impacting generation latency for customers in eu-west-1. Mitigations (scaling and routing changes) have reduced eviction rates. We will continue to monitor and may apply additional routing fallbacks if necessary. No data loss is expected.

maria (prod-sre): LGTM, small tweak: add estimated time window for next 2h.

jamal (secondary): FYI — I also opened a host-level ticket with infra: HT-9472, they will look for memory pressure pattern across the node pool.

leo (shift-lead): running checklist reminder: if we need to perform a full region failover, follow runbook section "regional-degrade-failover" and coordinate with customer-success for high-touch customers.

ops-bot: Pager cleared for embeddings-cache-eviction (INC-2026-478) — incident remains open while mitigation continues.

sara (primary): end-of-handoff summary: 
- primary: sara (me) until 01:45 UTC
- secondary: jamal until 02:00 UTC, then maria 02:00–04:00 UTC
- bridge: open (link to bridge pinned)
- current mitigations: +1 pod, PREFETCH_BATCH=0, partial routing to eu-central-1
- customer impact: p95 latency elevated, targeted customers notified soon
- runbook pointers: /runbooks/kv-cache-eviction, /runbooks/regional-degrade-failover

please ack if you have any questions or will take additional coverage. :thumbsup:

maria (prod-sre): ack — i'll be online and will update if anything changes.

jamal (secondary): ack, and i'll rejoin at 04:30 to take back secondary.

leo (shift-lead): thanks team. leaving note: keep incident open until eviction_rate < 10% and p95 latency within 100ms of baseline for 30m.

sara (primary): logging handoff in the ops-log and pinning this thread. thanks all."
